writing.publicSubset: Write & Improve and Falko–MERLIN only. LOCNESS-derived results remain local because its publication terms request sending an offprint, which is not authorized. Subsetting is a licensing decision, not model selection.

passReview.limitations: Offline staged diagnostic on the same development cases: reuse frozen outcomes of the unchanged first two requests, then invoke the added text-only checker for every retained pass. Remaining timeout is 60 seconds minus recorded parent elapsed time; this is not end-to-end latency validation. All three reviews use the same model and can repeat errors. No independent holdout, app-task qualification or human release approval.

data.context: Original-only 1000 characters before and after uniquely aligned target; gold edits never input. German punctuation whitespace detokenized.
data.labels: Original all-edit/no-correction labels unchanged. Annotation slices are not human re-adjudication.
data.splitPolicy: EN official train partition by hashed author. DE official train for development, unused official dev for holdout. Exclude old groups, known EN authors and targets; exclude cross-split group/author/target duplicates before sampling.

interruptedRuns.reason: Operational restart before inspecting candidate metrics: 48 GPU layers used 12878/16311 MiB but only about 4.2 generated tokens/s per slot; increase offload to 58 with unchanged prompts/data/criteria.
interruptedRuns.qualityResult: Incomplete; never used for model selection

limitations: The published development code evaluates the official test set each epoch; this is not an untouched qualification set.
Single-recording unpadded inference intentionally differs from the author's padded batch inference to avoid dependence on other recordings.
Only native-Mandarin English read speech; no evidence for German, Persian-L1 or spontaneous grammar.
Weight redistribution/deployment license not explicit in the model card; local research only.

scales.completeness: aggregate 0–10; individual binary 0/1; not used by candidate
